issues.title: Count widgets by part
issues.body:
## Motivation

The warehouse team counts stock by part number, and the inventory only gives one total.

## Acceptance Criteria

1. `by_part` returns each part's count.

issues.title: Warn when a restock run reads an empty inventory
issues.body: The nightly restock run reads the inventory and orders whatever is short. An empty inventory, as after a failed export, reads as every part short, so it orders everything. It should stop and say the inventory is empty.

issues.title: Report parts below a minimum count
issues.body:
## Motivation

The warehouse team needs the parts to reorder before the nightly restock run.

## Driving Requirements

### Acceptance Criteria

1. `low_stock(minimum)` lists each part whose count is under `minimum`, in part order.
2. A negative `minimum` raises `ValueError`.

comments.body: Approved for the next restock release.
